title: Refund request review
text: Refund requests need reviewer approval before any refund operation. The review window is seven days.

title: Password reset process
text: Password reset uses a single-use reset link valid for fifteen minutes. Support must never request the current password.

title: Ticket priority
text: Ticket priority P1 means a complete service outage. P2 means degraded service with a workaround.

title: Ticket data retention
text: Closed support ticket records are retained for thirty days in this fictional training service.

title: Attachment upload limit
text: Each attachment upload is limited to five megabytes. Executable attachments are rejected.

title: Refund review window
text: The other fictional tenant has a thirty-day refund review window.
